tytul: Zucchini caviar (ikra): why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for zucchini caviar (ikra), a spread of zucchini cooked down to a purée, canned in jars.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
NCHFP says not to try canning puréed vegetables, red meats or poultry at home, because proper processing times for puréed foods have not been determined for home use.
Canning summer squash without pickling is not recommended, because there is uncertainty about how to determine adequate processing times.

akapity: All fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canned zucchini caviar from a checked source.
